title: Safe-sync indexed OCI seeder + rollback-safe delta for on-prem airgap installs
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Adds an indexed OCI seeder that supports signed indexes, a seedless sync mode, and a safe-sync rollback mechanism. Updates terraform registry-mirror module and helm init containers to support offline rollout validation.
description:
Context: Customers running Private (on-prem / air-gapped) deployments require deterministic, verifiable seeding of OCI registries and a way to rollback to a previously-known-good offline bundle when an upgrade partially fails. This PR introduces an indexed OCI seeder that publishes a checksumed, signed index file alongside vendored images, a seedless 'pull-to-local' mode for constrained registries, and an atomic safe-sync + rollback path that can promote or revert bundle manifests without leaving partial state in local registries.

What this changes (high level): Implements an OCI index fingerprint file (index.sha256 + index.sig) produced at build time and consumed by the installer preflight; adds a "seedless" mode to the registry seeder where the installer only uploads missing blobs to a local mirror (useful for bandwidth-constrained sites); implements an atomic promote/rollback controller that stages manifests into a temporary namespace then switches a registry alias when promotion passes validation; extends preflight to validate signatures and free space before seeding; makes minor Helm chart updates to add an init-container that mounts the local registry TLS certs and runs a registry-vet check; updates the terraform module for registry-mirror to expose ACL and egress firewall rules and to add optional checksum validation.

Motivation: Prior offline installs sometimes left local registries in partial states after failed upgrades which complicated rollbacks and forced manual cleanup. Customers asked for a deterministic pointer (signed index) to the exact set of artifacts installed and an installer flow that can safely revert to the previous pointer without manual intervention. The seedless mode reduces up-front bandwidth for large airgap sites that prefer a staged pull.

Checklist: - [x] OCI index writer in build pipeline (signed with cosign) - [x] Installer preflight verifies index checksum and signature - [x] Seedless mirror mode (pull-only + stamp file) - [x] Atomic promote controller + revert path - [x] Helm chart init container + scripted registry-vet - [x] Terraform registry-mirror optional ACL rules + checksum toggle - [x] E2E on k3s and rke2 with 3-node airgapped topology - [x] Docs: upgrade/rollback section and migration notes

Migration notes: Existing on-prem sites are backwards compatible; when upgrading installer, operator may opt-in to verify index signatures by setting values.verifyIndexedSeed=true. The default is off to avoid sudden failures on old bundles. When enabling safe-sync, ensure you have at least 1.2x the size of the incoming bundle free in the target registry node (preflight will surface this requirement).

Security: Index files are signed via cosign in the build pipeline; the installer verifies the signature with a configurable key or keyserver. We've added audit events for promote and rollback actions to the installer audit log.

Testing: Local unit tests for index parsing and promote controller; integration harness tested against a private-local registry seeded via the new seedless flow; E2E runs were executed on k3s and rke2 images (see CI checks).

Related: ENG-4782 (safe-sync controller), ENG-5021 (airgap UX for seedless mirroring), SUP-1023 customer incident report.
commits: feat(seeder): add indexed OCI generation and signing; feat(installer): preflight verify-index + seedless mode; feat(promote): atomic promote controller with temporary staging; fix(helm): add init-container for registry TLS + vet; chore(terraform): add acl/egress options + checksum toggle; tests: e2e k3s/rke2 airgap harness; docs: upgrade/rollback guide
review_conversation:
Luca: Nice design, but the promote controller needs a clearer invariants doc (what happens if the staging push succeeds but vet fails). - Asha: Added explicit staging namespace cleanup and idempotent marker files; added preflight space check to avoid mid-push failures.
Maya: We should avoid changing default behavior for existing customers. Consider feature-flagging verifyIndexedSeed. - Asha: verifyIndexedSeed is opt-in by default; added config and docs.
Evan: Terraform changes look risky for users with strict egress rules. Can we make ACL toggles non-breaking? - Asha: Exposed toggle variables and left defaults to current behavior; added notes and examples for common firewall policies.
Luca: Observability — add metrics for promote successes/failures and rollback count. - Asha: Added promote_attempts_total and promote_rollback_total to audit/events and wired into prometheus collector.
Final review: Maya approved after minor doc tweak; Luca approved after invariants doc; Evan approved after terraform defaults confirmation.
ci_checks: CI summary: build: pass; lint: pass; unit-tests: pass; integration-tests: pass; e2e-airgap (k3s): flaky first run (timeout on registry push) -> rerun passed; e2e-airgap (rke2): pass; deployment-smoke: pass; security-scan: pass. Notes: one timeout resolved by increasing push timeout for low-bandwidth nodes. All green on final run.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash by Maya Kapoor (squash-merge). Release notes added to changelog under 2025-02-27. Back-merge to release/2025.02 prepared as separate PR.
notes_for_release_manager: Enable verifyIndexedSeed=false by default; ops should verify cosign public key rotation plan before enabling. Back-merge patch includes terraform var cleanup for older states.
changelog_entry: Added indexed OCI seeder with signature verification, seedless mirror mode, and an atomic safe-sync promote/rollback controller. Terraform module exposes ACL/egress toggles for registry-mirror. Helm charts include registry vet init-container.
qa_steps: 1) Build signed bundle via build/pipeline/cosign_sign.yaml 2) Run installer with --seedless and point to existing local registry 3) Trigger a promote then intentionally fail vet to validate rollback 4) Validate audit log contains promote and rollback events 5) Flip verifyIndexedSeed=true and run preflight against a bundle with invalid signature to ensure installer fails
notes: This PR intentionally avoids enabling signature verification by default to prevent disruption during staged rollouts. Operators should read docs/upgrade_rollback.md before enabling safe-sync in production.
